verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a public REST API that returns standard JSON (JSON API spec) and lets customers 'connect to any existing object' in their account. It also offers an MCP server for reading controls, tests, vendors, frameworks and risks, so data can be pulled out in an open format programmatically. There is, however, no documented bulk export, data-portability feature, or offboarding path. The CSV and API evidence describes importing data, not exporting it. missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk full-account export, an explicit export format list (CSV/JSON archives of policies, evidence files, etc.), an offboarding/data-retention-on-exit policy, and independent or hands-on confirmation that all data is retrievable.
